meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过小型脚本控制 Chromium 浏览器:打开网页、点击、填表、截图、提取数据,并在多次脚本运行间保留页面状态。遇到重复工作可写成脚本一次执行。
howto.when: 当用户要求打开网址、点击/填表、截图等浏览器操作,或说出“go to [url]”“click on”等短语时触发。

say.note: 会启动浏览器并返回截图

say.text: 去这个登录页,帮我填用户名和密码并提交
say.note: 会按你给的账号信息填表并提交

say.text: 抓取这个页面的所有文章标题和链接
say.note: 会提取数据并整理给你

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control a Chromium browser through small scripts: open pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots, and extract data. Page state persists across script runs, and repeated steps can be packaged into one script.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask for browser interactions such as opening a URL, clicking/filling forms, taking screenshots, extracting web data, or testing web apps, or when phrases like "go to [url]" or "click on" are used.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Launches the browser and returns the screenshot.

say_en.text: Go to the login page, fill in my username and password, then submit.
say_en.note: Fills and submits the form with the credentials you provide.

say_en.text: Scrape the article titles and links from this page.
say_en.note: Extracts the data and presents it to you.
